author: Athul Prem
body_scope: Left incidence at 1 GHz for the historical 26-hole device. The h160/h130 pair fixes nominal cubic Ge, 32 segments, two wall layers and the 99-DOF ports. Power sensitivity passes; complex response fails. The result does not establish convergence, reciprocity or a spectrum.
SAFE_scope: Independent semi-analytical finite-element lead calculation on two finer P2 sections. The |delta k| times length indicators describe lead-phase sensitivity and do not bound the full-device scattering error.
time_convention: exp(-i*omega*t); axial nodal forces use the +x normal at both ends
complex_encoding: [real, imaginary], scattering block rows are outgoing roots, columns are incoming roots. The two refined SAFE sections store negative-power U and F by exact complex conjugation of the positive-power arrays, verified against the raw checkpoints.
